Case studies

E-commerce, Jeddah

Local meat store: 70,000 to 220,000 SAR monthly sales in 60 days

Found that about 20% of products drove most sales, put the store's real advantages up front (lower prices, grass-fed quality, same-day delivery, a "Golden Guarantee", instalments), and tested Snapchat, TikTok and Google Ads.

  • TikTok became the winner platform on just 6,000 SAR of spend
  • Discovered the Nadhr & Fidya category, which opened sales across Saudi Arabia and brought in 35,000 SAR on its own
  • Expanded from Jeddah to Jeddah and Makkah

Food, Jeddah

Launching a healthy meal brand against heavy competition

Competitors relied on influencers and large budgets. We led with what they didn't offer: meals supervised by doctors and nutrition specialists, keto, weight-loss, bodybuilding and office programmes, instalments and fast delivery.

  • Purchases from day one on Snapchat
  • Campaign volume matched to the kitchen's daily capacity
  • Became one of Jeddah's top healthy food providers and earned spots at bodybuilding events
